headline: Ibovespa falls more than 1%, with Copom, overseas markets and earnings
summary: Brazil's Ibovespa index fell more than 1% in Thursday's session, as traders weighed the Copom central bank meeting, overseas markets and corporate earnings.
why: The Ibovespa is the benchmark index of the B3 exchange in São Paulo, tracking Brazil's largest listed companies. The Copom sets Brazil's Selic interest rate, a key driver of equity valuations.

impacts.name: Ibovespa
impacts.why: The index itself fell more than 1% in the session, as stated in the headline.
